OR

The bidder should be an Authorized representative of manufacturer meeting manufa cturers requirements of Electrically Operated Draw out (EOD) type of 300 amps or hi gher with minimum voltage rating of 415V Air Circuit Breakers with breaking current rating of 45KA or higher specifically authorized by the manufacturer for this tender. QR2. The bidder should have executed orders for supply of 415V Air Circuit Breakers” to a ny PSU/Central Government/State Government/Steel Industry/Power Plant/ any other process industries in India during the financial years from FY 2019-20 to FY 2025-26 ( both inclusive) in any of the following manner: a) Single Order with executed value not less than INR 122.00 Lakhs OR b) Two (2) Orders with executed value not less than INR 76.00 Lakhs each OR c) Three (3) Orders with executed value not less than INR 61.00 Lakhs each Note: - Reference work executed by the bidder as a sub-contractor may also be considered, provided the certificate issued by main contractor is duly certified by the Principal E mployer specifying the scope of work executed by the bidder. - The word “executed” means the bidder should have completed the work equivalent to the amount as specified in QR2, even though the total contract(s) is partially exe cuted, not completed / not closed. - In case of contract (s) is /are under execution as on last date of FY 2025-26 , the val ue of work executed till such date will be considered provided the principal employe r certifies the same. - All values mentioned above are excluding applicable taxes. QR3.

The average annual turnover of the bidder in the preceding 03 (Three) financial years , i.e. financial years FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 shall not be less tha n INR 152.00 Lakhs. Note: - Other income shall not be considered while computing annual turnover. In case the audited financial results for the last financial year are not available, financ ial results certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant shall be considered. If such certification is also not available, the audited results of the three consecutive financia l years preceding the last financial year shall be considered for evaluation. In such ca ses, a certificate from the CEO/CFO, as per the prescribed format enclosed in the bid ding documents, shall be submitted confirming that the latest financial results are un der audit and the Certificate from the practicing Chartered Accountant certifying the financial parameters is not available. QR4. The bidder should have valid - PAN, GST and EPFO registration. Notwithstanding anything stated above, RGPPL reserves the right to assess the capa bilities and capacity of the bidder to perform the contract, should the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of RGPPL.
